title: Command-Line Calculator
objective: Build a reliable calculator that accepts and evaluates user input.

milestones.title: Contract and data model
acceptance_criteria: Parse operands without crashing on malformed input.
Record the command and target environment used to verify behavior.

milestones.title: Core behavior
acceptance_criteria: Support add, subtract, multiply, and divide.
Record the command and target environment used to verify behavior.

milestones.title: Failure cases and tests
acceptance_criteria: Handle division by zero and unknown operations.
Record the command and target environment used to verify behavior.

milestones.title: Documentation and review
acceptance_criteria: Separate parsing, calculation, and display into functions.
Record the command and target environment used to verify behavior.

stretch_features: Add property-based or table-driven boundary tests.
Provide structured diagnostics and a repeatable CI quality gate.
tests: Unit tests for domain behavior and boundary conditions.
Integration tests for filesystem/network/platform boundaries where applicable.
Documented manual checks for target-specific behavior.
review_method: Human review plus `dart format .`, `dart analyze .`, relevant `dart test` runs, and target-specific integration checks. CodeLeaf does not execute submitted Dart code inside the FastAPI process.
status_note: Project brief derived from Section D of the supplied Dart curriculum. Starter code is a scaffold, not a finished project; locally verify the target SDK and platform.
